changes: New Feature: Listforge integration. You can now import lists from Listforge directly into Army Assist, using a soon to be released button from their end.
Updated the data sets to the newest codices.
Fixed several issues related to cyrillic characters in abilities and unit names
Updated the datasets for the new data pull from Wahapedia. This includes the new TSons codices.
Fixed some name mapping issues for Death Guard units with a new data pull from Wahapedia.
New Feature: Unit Notes! You can now add notes to individual units in your list. This is useful for keeping track of unit-specific strategies or reminders.
* To add a note, click on the notes icon to activate Force Edit Mode, then click on the pencil icon on the unit card to open the note management modal.
* You can add, edit or delete notes for each unit.
* Notes are saved locally in your browser, so they will persist across sessions BUT NOT ACROSS LIST REFRESHES.
* This feature is still in beta, so please report any issues you encounter.
* I intend to add the ability to export and import notes in the future.
New Feature: Leaders! You can now attach a unit to a leader in your list. This is useful for keeping track of which unit is leading a squad or a detachment.
* To attach a leader, click on the notes icon to activate Force Edit Mode, then click on the leader icon on the unit card to open the leader management modal.

* This will only display valid unit attachments. Note from the developer: I am not a 40k rules expert, so please let me know if you see any issues with this feature. I'm 99% certain this breaks with things such as Kroot having two leaders.
* Updates the print pages to include the leader information.
Fixed an issue where blank keywords were being displayed in the unit cards.
Now displays the unit keywords in the Pregame section of the print page
Fixed a weapon mapping issue with the Squighog Boyz, Kill Rig, and Rogal Dorn Commander. Thank you to my discord community for reporting this!
Added a text area to the Edit List Modal that allows you to edit the list text directly. This is useful for those who want to edit the list text without having to repaste it.
Fixed a weapon mapping issue with the Warboss in Mega Armour and the Beastboss on Squigosaur. Thank you to my discord community for reporting this!
Adjusted the layout of the stratagems button and the scroll to top button to not overlap with the last unit card in the list. This should make it easier to read the last data card on mobile devices.
Updated the datasets for the new data pull from Wahapedia. This includes the new Death Guard and World Eaters codices.
Added a Pregame print section to the print menu. This will allow you to print out the pregame abilities in a more readable format.
Fixed a bug with Canis Rex showing the Imperial Knights army rule in the phased ability breakdown. Thank you to my discord community for reporting this!

Adjusted the client-side storage solution to use localStorage instead of sessionStorage. This should prevent the need to repaste lists on browser session closure. Thank you to my discord community for the suggestion!
Fixed a bug with Emperor's Children lists not showing up properly. Thank you to my discord community for reporting this!

Added a new feature: Pregame Phase! This is a new phase on the phase tracker that narrows down specifically to pregame and start of the first battle round abilities. This will be useful for armies with lots of scout/infiltrate abilities.
Updated the datasets for the new data pull from Wahapedia.
Fixed a bug with how NR was exporting the lists for child units.
Added a new feature: Multiple Lists! This change is pretty immediately obvious upon log in. Special thanks to my patron Fenris for this request!
* Settings are now set on the Lists Display screen and synced across whichever list you select. No more per list setting fiddlyness.
* You can save several different lists and swap between them as needed.
* You can review your lists in either a tile or table view
* Allows you to rename lists
* Allows you to share a copy of the list as a QR code. Opening the QR code immediately takes you to a copy of the shared list.
* Added a new page to the print menu that prints out a QR Code.
* Allows you to share a copy of the list as a text link. Opening the text link immediately takes you to a copy of the shared list.
* Allows you to refresh the list through the data parser if your list is out of date
* Allows you to delete lists
Other Changes:
* Improved test case efficiency, which will have a knock on effect of fewer breaking pushes to prod
* Standardized icon size across the site
* Added a 'Truncate Core Rules' option for the main panes.
Bugfixes:
* Added a 'Reverse Paste Order' option for the sort method because the order being backwards for no apparent reason is really annoying.
* Fixed which buttons show in the header during non-army displays
* Fixed the phased printing sections doing weird things when stratagems and units are disabled.
* Continued improving Tau drone coverage
* Fixed a bug involving weapon profiles for unit counts
* Fixed a bug involving certain unicode apostrophes
Coming Soon:
* Allows you to edit a specific unit after it's gone through the processor for crusade support, applying abilities, etc

Implemented a new feature: Weapon Counts
* Added support for counting weapons from the list so you don't have to know off the top of your head
* This also converts weapon entries such as '2x Fusion Blaster' across 3 models into '6 Fusion Blasters'
* Some weapons have to be manually mapped and are not yet supported by this feature. This can be noted by a blank value.
* Kudos to the Patron Fenris for this feature request getting revisited in this release.
Implemented a new feature: Printing
* Printing allows for flexible print output formats to assist those of us who play to get away from digital tech
* Adds an option for removing units/stratagems from the print output
* Adds an option for truncating the core abilities on unit cards (Scouts, Infiltrators, etc.) to compact down cards
* Adds an option for phased stratagems vs. a compacted view
* Imports the option from the parent for filtering out weapons not on the list
